summary: Bearer gains Heal (Self) Unlimited (m) with Swift, usable only with no living enemy within 10'.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: The bearer must state Swift normally (N1).

params.change: the Heal granted by Regeneration may not be used within 10' of a living enemy

properties.note: Bearer must state "Swift" normally when using the granted Heal.

references.name: Heal
references.note: The granted Heal may not be used within 10' of a living enemy.

references.name: Swift
references.note: The granted Heal is cast with Swift, which must be stated normally.

clarifications.text: The bearer must state Swift normally when using the granted Heal.
The Heal granted by Regeneration may not be used within 10' of a living enemy; Regeneration itself has no such limit.
